name: Etapp 1 Hornöberget-Lövvik

officialSources.title: Höga Kusten-leden etapp 1 Hornöberget-Lövvik
findings: Current active section page lists 11.0 km, Svår, 5-6 h.
Start is Hotell Höga Kusten / Hornöberget, with transport via Hornöberget E4 and a mapped starting point at 62.803564, 17.951671.
Route follows the old coastal road via Nyadal, crosses Lövviksbron over Svartnorasundet, and continues to Lövvik.

campingNotes: No section-specific nature reserve restriction was found on the main route in section 1.
General allemansrätten applies outside protected areas/private home zones: keep distance from homes, avoid sensitive or cultivated land, and stay only briefly unless permission is obtained.
Sjöbodviken/Lövviks gästhamn is an end-area lodging/camping/service option; service details and booking/fees should be verified before user-facing copy.
shelterNotes: Kulberget / ArkNat Over the Edge is a notable shelter/rest/viewpoint candidate but has a Naturkartan-vs-OSM coordinate discrepancy; keep pending until map review.
Hornöberget has grill/shelter/picnic facilities around the hotel/start cluster, but many small benches/tables should be deduped into the start cluster.
fireNotes: Use prepared fireplaces where allowed and safe.
Check current fire-ban status via Krisinformation, Länsstyrelsen Västernorrland, or Räddningstjänsten Höga Kusten-Ådalen before relying on any fireplace.
Under stricter fire bans, even fixed public fireplaces may be prohibited.

protectedAreas.name: High Coast World Heritage area
protectedAreas.notes: The section is in/near the UNESCO High Coast context. No section-1 nature-reserve rule page was found for the walked line itself in the initial pass.

protectedAreas.name: Storön naturreservat
protectedAreas.notes: Visible/offshore nearby; not treated as a section-1 route restriction.

dogs: Dogs should be kept under control year-round.
From 1 March to 20 August, dogs must not run loose in nature.
hunting: Hunting/fishing are not included in allemansrätten.
Västernorrland elk hunting dates for 2025-2028 include 1-25 September and 10 October-31 January for licensed/management areas, with calf areas 1-5 September.
Jakt pågår signs are informational rather than automatic legal closures, but hikers should avoid disturbing active hunts and use high-visibility clothing in hunting season.
forestryAndPrivateLand: The route crosses mixed private/managed land; no section-1 forestry closure was found.
Temporary forestry or storm-damage closures may not surface in search; check current Naturkartan/Höga Kusten app and local signage before hiking.
terrainSafety: Official difficulty is Svår / Röd - krävande despite short distance.
Field reports describe road walking early, then rooty/rocky forest paths and short climbs.
Wet rock/roots may be slippery; trekking poles and sufficient water are recommended by field reports.

conditionReports.summary: Recent review reports few people and very good views; confirms normal passability but gives limited detail.

Field report describes first roughly 5 km as mostly flat road/asphalt, then forest path with stones, roots, and climbing. Notes that Lövvik service opening information may be unreliable and mentions a usable tap behind the restaurant.
conditionReports.confidence: high for summer field experience; medium for service currentness

conditionReports.summary: Informal recent comments warn Hornöberget can be slippery and steep but worthwhile for the view; also mention a good shelter/view near the bridge.
Review recommends bringing enough water, mentions road sections, narrow paths with roots/stones/boulders, mixed forest, and trekking poles.
Older user tips mention bus access, no supermarket near Hornöberget, water at public toilet/hotel area, limited bus frequency, and substantial road/paved walking on the wider trail.
Older track/report says orange waymarks were constant and the route was well marked through forest and coastal zones.

researchIterations.summary: Established current 9-section trail structure, identified active official section pages, confirmed section 1 GPX availability, and logged legacy 7-/13-stage source risks.

agents.summary: Confirmed official identity, current distance/time/difficulty, main route description, endpoint coordinate clues, official services, and parking/endpoint contradictions.
Validated Naturkartan GPX/API linework, computed route metrics, identified OSM relation 19096564, and documented endpoint/gap differences.
Collected start, mid-route, and end service/facility candidates with coordinates, confidence, route-proximity estimates, and import recommendations.
Verified Hornöberget E4 official bus access, closest/local start stop candidate, Lövvik bus stop coordinate/caveat, rail alternatives, parking, and guest-harbor access metadata.
Reviewed AllTrails, We12Travel, Reddit, Komoot, and Wikiloc reports for terrain, road walking, water/service reality, signage, and closure absence.
Checked public access, fire-ban policy, dogs, hunting, forestry/currentness, water reliability, and section-specific closure absence.

researchIterations.synthesisDecision: No extra agent batch needed before handoff. Remaining issues are normal integration-time caveats or targeted map-review items, not blockers for a research-ready section packet.

openQuestions: Should the normalized endpoint coordinate remain the Naturkartan GPX endpoint, or should the section detail UI emphasize Sjöbodviken/Lövviks gästhamn as the practical end service cluster?
Verify current Hornöberget parking fee/long-stay terms with Hotell Höga Kusten or current on-site/source text before public copy.
Resolve Kulberget/Over the Edge coordinate discrepancy before importing the shelter.
Verify Lövvik B&B coordinate from an official or map source before importing.
Confirm current seasonal opening hours for Lövviks Restaurang Café / Livs close to import time.
If commute data is later imported from GTFS, replace hand-collected DinTur stop coordinates with authoritative stop ids/coordinates.
